title: 第11章  防御大阵破了，魔族大军现
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
一道道目光全部落在了谢莲心身上，谢莲心落在城墙上，看了眼外面的孙铭，一对视，她目光中闪过杀意。
这家伙身上有魔气。
魔族，绝对是魔族。
前世佳孟关要塞被攻破过，几乎整个要塞的人都死绝了。因为前世她在关禁闭，没有来佳孟关，到底怎么破的，细节她不清楚，但是这要塞从外面攻破的难度是从里面攻破的一百倍以上。
“这几个人就算不是魔族变化的，也可能已经被魔族控制了，要是他们一进来就大开杀戒，后果谁能承担？”谢莲心道。
“有杜师兄和诸位师兄师姐在，就算有事也定能解决，难道要见死不救吗？”柳如烟反驳。
“我们可以不进去，放周师妹进去好吗？她快要不行了，你们救救她！”孙铭在外面声音悲怆。
其他人也道：
“我们可以不进去。”
“你们救救周师妹。”
“求求诸位玄天宗道友了！”
“五行宗日后感激不尽！”
柳如烟一听，看着谢莲心，焦急地道：“师姐，你听到了没有，那位周道友快不行了。”
“不能放！他们肯定有鬼！”谢莲心道，“诸位师兄师姐，你们驻守这里这么多年，还不知道魔族多狡诈吗？”
外面孙铭等人全部跪下了，一个个面容凄惨，带着祈求：“我们给你们跪下了。求求你们救救我们师妹吧！”
“都是仙盟的修士，诸位道友真忍心见死不救吗？”
大部分高阶修士虽有触动但不言语。
柳如烟道：“杜师兄让他们进来吧。直接关押起来救治就是了。我们人这么多，他们就是魔族又能成什么气候？”
谢莲心道：“你想的太简单了。”
“师姐，你就不要阻拦了。”柳如烟道。

“他们一进来，立刻就杀人，你们信不信？”谢莲心握着拳头道。
“少危言耸听了，你就是不想救而已。”宋璇说着风凉话。
“师姐，你心太狠了！”柳如烟说完这句，看着众人大义凛然地道，“诸位师兄师姐，今日要是出事了，由我一人承担。我会自己跟师尊请罪！杜师兄，快下令吧！”
杜信见柳如烟望向自己，楚楚可怜的脸此刻平添了几分坚毅，更觉得她惹人怜爱了，他立刻就再度下令：“放行！”
谢莲心想阻止来不及了，阵法师们这次施术速度很快，防御大阵
外面，五行宗的孙铭低着头露出阴谋得逞的笑容。
那个昏迷中的周师妹立即就好了，这五个五行宗的弟子瞬间就化成了五道疾驰的闪电，以迅雷不及掩耳之势从那“门”中射入了要塞。这一转变，让众人大惊失色。
不好！！
孙铭没有冲入来就立即杀人，但是他瞬间就攻击了法阵的中枢。
他身上的威压一下子就从大乘期飙升到了渡劫期的巅峰，身上环绕着红黑色的魔气，魔气在他左手凝成了一杆红黑色的长枪，这长枪带着红色的闪电，带着恐怖的力量，破坏了一重重的禁制法阵，击中了悬浮在天空中的巨大的浅金色球体。
轰隆一声巨响，那似是一轮圆月般的防御阵法中枢就爆炸了。
要塞剧烈震动！
冲击波朝着四周扩散去，周围的建筑瞬间崩塌，数百名驻守要塞的弟子被波及非死即伤。
谢莲心躲开飞射而来的碎片，气得在心里大骂。
笼罩着整一座要塞的防御大阵消失了，那巨大的浅金色的罩子不见了，众人当即是个个面无血色。
柳如烟傻眼了，心如坠冰窖。
“哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈……”
孙铭大笑着朝着一座高塔冲去，其余的四人也是冲向了高塔。谢莲心大喊道：“拦住他们！”
要塞的防御阵法被破坏的话，还有备用的法阵，那些高塔是备用法阵的阵眼所在。一旦全部被破坏，才是完蛋了。
霍嫣等高手们立即化为道道长虹冲向了最近的阵眼，但是孙铭他们速度太快了，砰砰砰地一下子连毁了数个阵眼。

杜信手持长剑挡在了孙铭的面前，他知道自己犯下大错了，现在只能是尽力地弥补。
杜信挥手间一道道寒冰剑气化为了一把把的冰剑朝着孙铭激射而去，孙铭只是一挥手将袭来的冰剑全部都打碎了。孙铭的速度极快，交手几回合，杜信就被他一拳轰飞出去百里之远。
前面几个修士挡在孙铭面前，后面就是一座高塔，高塔中就是阵眼。孙铭冷笑了两声，大股红光从他体内涌出，瞬间击杀了那几个修士。
他手指一点，一道黑红色光芒从他指尖激射而出，眼看着那道光芒就要击中前面的阵眼。
忽地，四道身影出现在了高塔前面，那是四个一模一样的少女，都梳着高髻，穿着彩色的衣裙，绾着白色的长飘带，并且都是大乘后期的修为。
四个少女一起结印，符文闪烁，四个圆形的法阵连接成一个巨大的紫色光盾，挡下了那道红色光芒。
孙铭定眼一看，惊讶地道：“傀儡？”
炼金傀儡？大乘后期的炼金傀儡？
孙铭心中震惊无比，因为从未见过这么高等级的炼金傀儡。
谢莲心翩然落在高塔上，她站在高塔上打了个响指，旁边具出现了十六具同样的大乘后期的炼金傀儡。谢莲心手指一指，那十六具傀儡就一起朝着孙铭杀去了。
谢莲心将这些傀儡叫做天女，天女或是弹着琵琶，或是吹奏着玉笛，或是抱着七弦琴、或是打着手鼓、或是拿着刀剑长弓将孙铭给包围了，加起来一共二十个天女围殴，孙铭一下子就狼狈了。
这些天女不是普通傀儡，她们会布阵，会思考，会配合。
轰隆隆——
孙铭被她们联手攻击之下，竟然被打飞了出去。
其他人看得目瞪口呆的。
傀儡，大乘后期的傀儡，还这么多？
柳如烟看得妒火中烧，她以为自己有，师尊居然给了她二十个，自己只有四个。她不知道这是谢莲心自己制作的，以为是谢逸给的。
众人都震惊无比。但很快他们的震惊就被恐惧所取代了，魔气滔滔从天边而来。
密密麻麻的魔族如同潮水地从远处的天空那边出现了，天空血红一片，各种形态的魔族连接现身。
content_en:
All eyes fell on Xie Lianxin. Xie Lianxin fell on the city wall and glanced at Sun Ming outside. When they looked at each other, murderous intent flashed in her eyes.
There's something demonic about this guy.
Demons, definitely demons.
The Jiameng Pass Fortress was breached in the previous life, and almost all the people in the fortress died. Because she was in solitary confinement in her previous life and did not come to Jiameng Pass, she didn't know the details of how it was broken, but it was more than a hundred times more difficult to break through the fortress from the outside than from the inside.
"Even if these people are not transformed by the demon clan, they may have been controlled by the demon clan. If they start killing as soon as they come in, who can bear the consequences?" Xie Lian thought to herself.
"With Senior Brother Du and all the other senior brothers and sisters here, even if something happens, we will be able to solve it. Are we going to die without saving him?" Liu Ruyan retorted.
"We can't go in and let Junior Sister Zhou in, okay? She's dying, please save her!" Sun Ming's voice was sad outside.
Others also said:
"We don't have to go in."
"Save Junior Sister Zhou."
"Please, fellow Taoists of Xuantian Sect!"
"The Five Elements Sect will be grateful in the future!"
When Liu Ruyan heard this, she looked at Xie Lianxin and said anxiously: "Senior sister, have you heard that Fellow Daoist Zhou is about to die?"
"Can't let go! They must have ghosts!" Xie Lian thought to herself, "Brothers and sisters, you have been stationed here for so many years, don't you know how cunning the demons are?"
Outside, Sun Ming and others all knelt down, each with a miserable look on his face, and prayed: "We kneel down for you. Please save our junior sister!"
"They are all monks from the Immortal Alliance. Do you fellow Taoists really have the heart to do nothing to save you?"
Most of the senior monks were touched but did not speak.
Liu Ruyan said: "Senior Brother Du, let them in. Just imprison them for treatment. There are so many of us, what can they do if they are demons?"
Xie Lian thought: "You think too simply."
"Sister, please don't stop me." Liu Ruyan said.
"As soon as they came in, they immediately killed people. Do you believe it?" Xie Lianxin said with her fists clenched.
"Stop being alarmist, you just don't want to save me." Song Xuan said sarcastically.
"Senior sister, you are so cruel!" After Liu Ruyan said this, he looked at everyone and said with dignity, "Senior brothers and sisters, if something happens today, I will bear the responsibility alone. I will plead guilty to the master myself! Senior brother Du, give the order quickly!"
Du Xin saw Liu Ruyan looking at him, her pitiful face now filled with determination, and he felt that she was even more lovable. He immediately ordered again: "Let her go!"
Xie Lian thought that it was too late to stop her. The formation masters cast their spells very quickly this time, and the defensive formation
Outside, Sun Ming from the Five Elements Sect lowered his head and showed a smile of success.
The comatose Junior Sister Zhou recovered immediately, and the five Five Elements Sect disciples instantly turned into five streaks of lightning, shooting into the fortress from the "door" at lightning speed. This change shocked everyone.
not good! !
Sun Ming did not rush in and kill immediately, but he instantly attacked the center of the circle.
The coercion on his body suddenly soared from the Mahayana stage to the peak of the Tribulation stage. He was surrounded by red and black demonic energy. The demonic energy condensed into a red and black spear in his left hand. This spear carried red lightning and terrifying power. It destroyed multiple layers of forbidden magic circles and hit the huge light golden sphere suspended in the sky.
With a loud bang, the defensive formation center that looked like a full moon exploded.
The fortress shook violently!
The shock wave spread in all directions, and the surrounding buildings collapsed instantly. Hundreds of disciples stationed in the fortress were either killed or injured.
Xie Lianxin dodged the flying debris and cursed in her heart with anger.
The defensive formation covering the entire fortress disappeared, the huge light golden cover disappeared, and everyone's faces immediately turned pale.Liu Ruyan was dumbfounded, and her heart felt like it was falling into an ice cellar.
"Hahahahahahahaha..."
Sun Ming laughed and rushed towards a high tower, and the other four people also rushed towards the tower. Xie Lianxin shouted: "Stop them!"
If the fortress's defensive formation is destroyed, there will still be a backup formation, and those high towers will be the eyes of the backup formation. Once everything is destroyed, it's over.
Huo Yan and other masters immediately turned into rainbows and rushed towards the nearest formation. However, Sun Ming and the others were too fast and destroyed several formations in a row.
Du Xin stood in front of Sun Ming with a long sword in his hand. He knew that he had made a big mistake and now he could only try his best to make up for it.
Du Xin waved his hand, and the ice sword energy turned into ice swords and shot towards Sun Ming. Sun Ming just waved his hand and smashed all the ice swords that came towards him. Sun Ming was extremely fast. After a few rounds of fighting, Du Xin was sent flying hundreds of miles away with one punch.
A few monks stood in front of Sun Ming, and behind was a high tower, and in the high tower was the formation eye. Sun Ming sneered twice, and a large stream of red light surged out of his body, instantly killing the monks.
He pointed his finger, and a black-red light shot out from his fingertips. He was about to hit the formation in front of him.
Suddenly, four figures appeared in front of the tower. They were four identical girls. They all wore high buns, colorful dresses, and long white ribbons. They were all in the late Mahayana period.
The four girls formed seals together, the runes flickered, and the four circular magic circles connected into a huge purple light shield, blocking the red light.
Sun Ming took a closer look and said in surprise: "Puppet?"
Alchemy puppet? An alchemical puppet from the late Mahayana period?
Sun Ming was extremely shocked because he had never seen such a high-level alchemy puppet before.
Xie Lian's heart suddenly fell on the high tower. She stood on the high tower and snapped her fingers. Sixteen identical alchemy puppets from the late Mahayana period appeared next to her. Xie Lianxin pointed her finger, and the sixteen puppets all started to kill Sun Ming.
Xie Lianxin called these puppets the Goddess. The Goddess were playing the pipa, the jade flute, holding the lyre, playing the tambourine, or holding swords and long bows. They surrounded Sun Ming. A total of twenty Goddess surrounded and beat him. Sun Ming was suddenly in a panic.
These goddesses are not ordinary puppets, they can form formations, think, and cooperate.
Rumble——
Sun Ming was attacked by them and was actually knocked away.
Others looked dumbfounded.
There are so many puppets in the late Mahayana period?
Liu Ruyan was filled with jealousy. She thought she had it, but the master actually gave her twenty, and she only had four. She didn't know that Xie Lianxin made it herself, and thought it was given to her by Xie Yi.
Everyone was shocked. But soon their shock was replaced by fear, and the demonic energy surged from the sky.
Densely packed demons appeared like a tide from the distant sky. The sky was blood red, and various forms of demons appeared one after another.
